lane: Notes D61/D62/D63/D67/D68 member native acceptance readiness

source_artifact.claim: The runner invokes verifyImportedNativeEvidence before and after the native run. This checks original CI and local receipts, provenance, GitHub run/artifact identity, archive digest, manifest, tree bytes, and current-source relation. The result records returned source and run provenance.

procedure: Reserve the exclusive native browser/heavy resource permit. Do not run this concurrently with another browser or test process.

Use the existing mode-0600 test-results/files-saved-private-config.json, which contains the authorized reviewer email fingerprint. The runner never records the email, password, or auth token. The reviewer enters their existing credentials into the headed, genuine www.aimatrx.com/login form when STAGE ready_manual_member_login appears.

Run with NOTES_ROLE=member NOTES_INTERACTIVE_MEMBER=1 NOTES_PRIVATE_CONFIG=/Volumes/Samsung2TB/code/matrx-extend/test-results/files-saved-private-config.json NOTES_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA=2a5fbe64686b8f32dea8f904bb92f70bbf6e2d9a NOTES_DEV_BUILD_RECEIPT=/Volumes/Samsung2TB/code/matrx-extend/test-results/ci-artifacts/2a5fbe64686b8f32dea8f904bb92f70bbf6e2d9a/37039513091-1/local-dev-receipt.json node tests/browser/notes-native-acceptance.mjs under that resource permit.

At STAGE ready_manual_member_organization, the reviewer selects an existing organization in the extension's Acting as picker. The runner requires a fresh selection from Choose…, a matching web/extension account, and a successful empty canonical admin.admins result for the current extension user before Notes operations.

The runner injects only scoped workbench.notes transport failures, verifies recovery through the real UI, captures one successful created-note response ID, and writes it immediately to an ignored mode-0600 notes-owned-fixture-*.json receipt. D63 checks persisted content after panel reload; D68 deletes only this owned ID and checks absence after reload.

Inspect test-results/notes-native-acceptance.json plus the named private fixture receipt. If the run stops after creation, use the exact receipt note_id and a matching detail GET in the same organization before any UI cleanup. Never delete by title alone or scan/delete unrelated Notes.
static_validation: git diff --check on owned runner: pass
limits: No test, browser, build, release, or authenticated run was executed in this readiness lane.

The current role proof establishes a real signed-in reviewer with no extension admin assignment. The picker proves organization membership but does not expose its IAM role; a strict organization-role=member claim needs separate authorized role evidence.
The existing D62 fault is a preflight failed POST, not an ambiguous committed insert with a lost response.
If the successful create response cannot yield exactly one UUID, the runner fails before editing or deleting and retains a private failure result; any created row then needs manual exact-ID recovery.
